builds.title: Hardened architecture foundation: layout/theme/plugin contracts, Pydantic migrator + namespacing, plugin boundary + lifecycle broker, docs
builds.detail: From Brett's attachment (Oct 27 2026): 5 deliverables — TS data contracts (layout & component tree, theme engine, plugin manifest), Pydantic v2 validator/migrator + ingestion namespacing, React error boundary + pub/sub lifecycle broker, project spec, developer docs (new plugin, harvesting, live sync). Built ON the existing contracts (asset@1, plugin@1, appearance@1), not beside them. Web + Python; Android twins deferred.

steps.text: Gap audit: map attachment items 1-3 onto what exists (asset@1 layout, color/style themes, plugin@1, AxfWebLibrary, settings, embed); write _claude/memory/docs/arch-foundation.md listing only what is new. Do not duplicate existing contracts.
Layout & component tree contract (TS): page → widget/plugin nodes with unique ids, dimensions, bounding boxes, asset dependencies; additive to layout@ assets; fixture + checker.
Theme contract additions: component-specific overrides on top of color/style themes (tokens only); fixture.
plugin@1 manifest additions: declared assets, default settings, layout entry points (optional fields, old manifests still valid); schema + validators.

Pydantic v2 models mirroring items 1-3 + migration engine (@model_validator(mode="before")): up-cast legacy versions, fill missing fields, sanitise; never crash old apps. framework/python/axf/contracts/.
Ingestion namespace engine: prefix every harvested plugin key as plugin_id:property (state + assets), idempotent, collision report; same rules in TS + Python, one fixture.
Lifecycle event broker (TS): onInit / onStateChange / onThemeUpdate / onContextMenuOpen / onDestroy, typed message passing, plugins never touch global state; fixture.
React PluginBoundary: error boundary around every mounted plugin (layout + context-menu hooks), isolate the widget, themed fallback stub, report to rt.diagnostics.
Architecture spec: add the new contracts to CLAUDE.md status + a reference layout tree in framework/spec/ARCH-FOUNDATION.md (no second .claude.md: CLAUDE.md is the project file).
Developer guide part 1: build a new plugin (manifest, layout/theme hooks, lifecycle hooks) in apps/console-web/plugins/README.md.
Developer guide part 2: how harvesting works + how live sync works (hub appearance@1, migrations) in framework/spec/.
Tests in CI for the new checkers + Python test; THREADS.md + PORTING.md (Android twins deferred).

builds.title: Three complete interfaces in GizmoX tabs + an interface roller for every app
builds.detail: Brett, Oct 27 2026 13:10: "Create 3 completely different looks, feels, behavior. Existing look now in a tab holding main window and 2 more tabs with entirely worked out GUIs that are essentially different apps as far as look is concerned. Make plugin for this app and every app to roll a new interface that rebuilds every single thing about user interface, menus, context menus, logos, etc." Needs enterprise-branding phase 1 (design package, behaviour, branding, logo and icon-pack types + generators) first. Web only; Android deferred.

notes.text: Runs after enterprise-branding phase 1 (s1-s12), whose asset types and generators it uses. One switch: Fable s1-s5, then Opus s6-s15.

steps.text: interface@1: one asset that names a whole interface: design package (style, colour, layout, behaviour), branding (logos, animated logos, icon pack), every chrome asset (banner, app menu, toolbar, nav, context menus, tab group, settings interface, dialog/window/container styles). Open slot list, so new chrome joins by itself.
Scoped runtime: the same app drawn under several interfaces at once (one asset scope + CSS scope per interface, nothing leaks between them). Engine part + fixture.
steps.why: runtime internals (theme scoping was never built)

steps.text: React layer: <InterfaceScope id> wraps a subtree; AppShell, menus, context menus, dialogs, floating windows and portals honour the scope.
steps.why: changes how GUIs work across apps

Interface 2 part 1: an entirely different look, feel and behaviour (design package, branding, chrome assets).
Interface 2 part 2: menus, context menus, dialogs, windows and containers worked out and checked on every page.
Interface 3 part 1: a third, entirely different look, feel and behaviour.
Interface 3 part 2: menus, context menus, dialogs, windows and containers worked out and checked on every page.
The GizmoX console's main window becomes a tab group: Main (today's look, unchanged) · Interface 2 · Interface 3, each tab the full app under its own interface scope.
Interface roller console plugin 1/2: Roll, lock parts, roll again, preview in a new tab, undo.
Roller 2/2: save as an interface@1 asset, apply to one tab or the whole app, export / import, settings tab + lifecycle.
Harvest it as framework library lib-interface-roller so every AXF web app can install it (console, AmberX, axHub web, Patches web, Walkthrough Studio); library@1 parts.
Install the library in the AmberX app and the other web apps; check each one builds and rolls.
